items.title: IPS Impact Awards 2026: celebrating this year’s winners
items.summary: We’re delighted to announce the winners of the IPS Impact Awards 2026, celebrating the individuals, teams and volunteers making an outstanding contribution to infection prevention and control (IPC).

items.title: Joanne Taylor elected as next Vice President of the Infection Prevention Society
items.summary: We are delighted to announce that Joanne Taylor has been elected as the next Vice President of the Infection Prevention Society (IPS). Joanne is DIPC and IPC Consultant Nurse at Royal Cornwall Hospital NHS Trust and Cornwall Partnership NHS Foundation Trust.

items.title: Gram-negative, MRSA and MSSA bacteraemia and C. difficile: annual commentary 2025/26
items.summary: UKHSA's mandatory HCAI surveillance for FY 2025/26: MRSA bacteraemia up again to 1,144 cases (2.0 per 100k), reversing years of stability; MSSA up again to 23.8 per 100k (13,948); E. coli 44,879 cases (+2.6%), Klebsiella +3.7%, P. aeruginosa +5.5%, rises mainly community-onset. C.

items.title: Remembering Peter Hoffman
items.summary: It is with great sadness that we remember Peter Hoffman, who worked in the field of infection prevention and control (IPC) for more than 40 years. Peter was a trusted and widely respected source of advice on a broad range of issues relating to the transmission of infection in healthcare settings.
